# opnsense_interfaces_settings (Resource)

Global interface settings (**Interfaces ▸ Settings**): hardware offloading, VLAN hardware filtering, IPv6 and the DHCPv6 client. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `interfaces_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_interfaces_settings.this
  id = "interfaces_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_interfaces_settings" "this" {
  disable_checksum_offloading = true
  vlan_hw_filter              = "2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dhcp6_debug` (Boolean) Debug logging of the DHCPv6 client.
- `dhcp6_duid` (String) DHCPv6 DUID, empty to let the system generate one.
- `dhcp6_no_release` (Boolean) Do not send a DHCPv6 release when the WAN goes down.
- `dhcp6_ra_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for a router advertisement before starting the DHCPv6 client. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `disable_checksum_offloading` (Boolean) Disable hardware checksum offloading.
- `disable_ipv6` (Boolean) Block all IPv6 traffic.
- `disable_large_receive_offloading` (Boolean) Disable hardware large receive offloading (LRO).
- `disable_segmentation_offloading` (Boolean) Disable hardware TCP segmentation offloading (TSO).
- `vlan_hw_filter` (String) VLAN hardware filtering: `0` enable, `1` disable, `2` leave the driver default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `interfaces_settings`.
